article.title: How about ACORN to Stop the Budget Bill Cutbacks?
article.author: Wade Rathke
article.content: Over the last year, more than 5 million people lost SNAP benefits–often called food stamps–across the United States at an accelerated pace that the Congressional Budget Office had not expected until 2030.
